#### List:

- Absorption
- Distribution
- Metabolism
- Excretion

#### Absorption:

+---------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Oral    | - ↓Gastric emptying in labour → ↑risk aspiration                                                     |
+---------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Inhaled | - ↑VA (progesterone on respiratory centre), ↓FRC (diaphragm compression) → ↑rate of volatile wash-in |
|         | - (partly offset by ↑cardiac output)                                                                 |
+---------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| SC/IM   | - ↑blood flow → ↑absorption rate (e.g. IM morphine in labour)                                        |
+---------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Distribution:

+----------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Cardiac output | - ↑CO due to ↑preload, ↓afterload, ↑heart rate                                     |
|                | - ↑Rate of onset suxamethonium                                                     |
|                | - ↑Rate of offset by distribution of propofol → risk of awareness                  |
|                | - Slows onset of volatile anaesthetic (but ↑V~A~:FRC ratio is more significant)    |
+----------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Blood          | - ↓Albumin → ↑free acidic drug (e.g. barbiturate) (note same total amount albumin) |
|                | - ↓AAG → ↑free basic drug (e.g. morphine)                                          |
|                | - Respiratory alkalosis → ↑% unionized basic drugs, ↓%unionised acidic drug        |
|                | - ↑Blood volume → ↑V~D~ plasma-confined drugs e.g. heparins                        |
+----------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Tissues        | - ↑Muscle mass, ↑fat mass, oedema, ↑body water                                     |
|                | - Hence ↑V~D~ most drugs → ↑t~1/2~~β~ most drugs                                   |
+----------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Metabolism and excretion:

+--------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Liver  | - Unchanged hepatic blood flow and liver function                     |
|        | - Progesterone → CYP enzyme induction                                 |
|        | - Oestrogen → CYP enzyme competition                                  |
|        | - ↓\[Plasma cholinesterase\] but unchanged amount                     |
+--------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Kidney | - ↑Renal blood flow 80% → ↑GFR → ↑excretion unchanged drugs e.g. LMWH |
+--------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
